Guidelines for Writing Essay

An essay is a brief piece of writing on a particular subject or topic. There are two different types of essays that can be written: formal essays and informal essays. Writings that are primarily scholarly in nature are called formal essays.

How to write a comparative essay?

A comparative essay is composed of several paragraphs that attempt to explain how two issues are either similar or different from one another. In these pieces, contrasting and comparing various aspects of the subjects under discussion is a major focus.

How to write a reflective essay?

A reflective essay is a type of academic essay writing in which you can share your ideas and findings on a certain topic.This kind of paper can convey your thoughts and feelings in connection with an event or a text.
